description: Lockstep and replay: when the composition chooses the determinism profile, libraries that simulate run deterministic builds, glue compiles without floating-point contraction, and a fixed simulation gives the same result on every platform.

deterministic.description: Whether this build of the library gives the same results on every platform for the same inputs and call order.

defines.description: The defines a deterministic build sets.

conditions.description: What else determinism depends on, such as call order or thread count.

profile.description: Whether the composition is deterministic: off, or on for lockstep networking and replays.

rules.text: Every library with determinism facts is in a deterministic build, and glue compiles without floating-point contraction (-ffp-contract=off; MSVC /fp:precise).
rules.procedure: verify reads each library's determinism facts in its chosen variant; the CLI writes the floating-point options into automap.cmake when the profile is on.

seeded_violation.description: Choose the determinism profile while Jolt's variant isn't a deterministic build.

rules.text: A fixed simulation the library's binding runs from fixed inputs gives the replay hash its recipe records, on every platform.
Game code applies inputs and creates objects in the same order on every peer; deterministic libraries promise the same result only for the same calls in the same order.
